text_block_list.text:
Since Mejiro Palmer hasn't been in good 
form lately, we decided to go pray at the 
shrine together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...I did make the request, though. Is 
this really okay...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, normally, we don't really have 
anything to do with the gods, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, only asking for favors when I'm 
in trouble feels kinda... you know, not 
right."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to at least do something nice to 
repay the gods, y'know? Isn't there some 
good karma I can build up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Oh! There's a bamboo broom over there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If we use that to clean this place up, 
wouldn't that build up good karma? Like 
helping out with house chores!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's make it so clean even the 
gods will be amazed!

And so, Mejiro Palmer and I set to work 
cleaning the shrine grounds together—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's super clean now! I think it'll 
be fine to ask them like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Well then, once more... please, God.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Still, cleaning up really leaves 
you feeling refreshed, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"It's like my heart feels refreshed... Or 
maybe, I just feel free?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Could this be... what they call a blessing 
from the gods?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, God! Please watch over me in 
the next race too!

Mejiro Palmer seems to have fully 
recovered. In my heart, I decided to thank 
the gods as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
With this, it'll surely be okay to make a 
wish to God—

"...Yet, at that very moment, a strong 
gust of wind blew, scattering all the 
trash that had been so painstakingly swept 
up."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa~!? You've gotta be kidding me~!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I have to sweep it all over again...! Um, 
broom, broom...!

Making wishes to the gods isn't easy 
either... In the end, I couldn't help 
Mejiro Palmer shake off her slump.
